status: review recommendations only; no content repairs

findings.title: Fixed acceptance denominator is caller-controlled
findings.evidence: After the normal confirmed effect, accept(1,1) and accept(9,9) both close the operation despite the fixed 10/10 policy; baseline tests only reject 8/10 and accept 10/10.
findings.remedy: Bind required total/pass count to persisted work policy; fixed lab can require exactly 10/10.
findings.acceptance: 1/1, 9/9 and 8/10 reject; 10/10 with confirmed effect and authorized owner succeeds.

findings.title: Contradictory terminal observations have no visible diagnostic
findings.evidence: A deliberately faulty provider returns rejected then applied; reconciliation retains rejected without reporting conflict. Same-state changed receipt also leaves the full journal row unchanged and returns awaiting_acceptance. Normal immutable provider observations remain correct.
findings.remedy: Preserve established facts and expose/store contradictory observations; distinguish stale accepted from applied-versus-rejected conflict.
findings.acceptance: Both contradictory terminal arrival orders and changed same-state receipt create a visible conflict; late accepted does not erase applied; no replacement operation is generated.

findings.title: V21 reservation exercise loses per-request quantity
findings.evidence: Normal S1/S2 quantities are 10+6. Prose requires one success for two reservations of the remaining 16 without saying each requests 16; JSON specifies two requests of 16 each.
findings.remedy: Restore per-request quantities and distinguish competing test requests from normal S1/S2. Explain version-conflict retry separately from shortage.
findings.acceptance: 16+16 against 16 cannot both commit; 10+6 can both succeed after appropriate serialization/retry and leave zero.

findings.title: H03 manufacturing transfer names H07 BI
findings.evidence: TR:H03:H07:dependency-not-capacity is described using production equipment/material/process constraints, but H07 is BI and V07 is manufacturing. The additional-reading proposal repeats the same context; this is not one of the 42 selected map edges.
findings.remedy: Either retarget consistently to V07, or retain H07 with its actual conditions. Add clickable destination and update every affected stable reference.
findings.acceptance: Destination chapter matches the described transfer; proposal ID and stored occurrence agree; preserve dependency-versus-capacity reasoning.

findings.title: Promised executable verification route disappears after Books migration
findings.evidence: P01 introduction has no commands between its Python introduction and first/second/third descriptions. V02 says scripts are in this directory, but they are in Vault. Package index calls JSON adjacent to prose although retained JSON is in Vault. All-book runner exists.
findings.remedy: Restore named linked commands with working directory and scope, or one concise case-to-command table. Correct directory-relative wording. Keep learner checks distinct from registry maintenance.
findings.acceptance: A reader can reach the arithmetic check from the advertised entry, run it without installing dependencies, and identify its limited scope.
findings.support: cases-finance-commerce.md: FC-02; cases-health-industry.md: HI-03; cases-people-data.md: PD-04

findings.title: First-use vocabulary is missing at method-selection points
findings.evidence: Examples absent from inspected local/index definitions include EAM/CMMS/FSM, PLM/MES/CAE, SDC/SPEF, OSS/BSS, EHR/HIS/LIS, CRA, ITSM, PSA, SIEM/SOAR, CAS/CLM, DML, REST, CU, PCCO and IWMS. These have different system, method, provider or synthetic-unit roles.
findings.remedy: Expand at first explanatory use, define the role briefly, and provide stable glossary entries where useful. Verify provider-specific expansions from their primary source before adopting them.
findings.acceptance: A reader can select/search the named family or explain a changed input without guessing the acronym, and distinguish synthetic CU from a currency standard.
findings.support: cases-health-industry.md: HI-02; cases-people-data.md: PD-02; cases-finance-commerce.md: FC-04

findings.title: Two calculation conventions are unstated
findings.evidence: H01 uses floor and clamp without definition. Foundations uses [1,4) to select 1,3,0 from [2,1,3,0,4] without saying positions start at zero, after discussing numbered days. Both numerical examples are correct.
findings.remedy: Define clipping and rounding operators beside the formula; state zero-based array positions with a small indexed row or sentence.
findings.acceptance: Reader obtains zero before s, full amount after e and original 33/33/34 allocation; reader identifies positions 1,2,3 and prefix values correctly.
findings.support: cases-finance-commerce.md: FC-03; coordinator full foundations reading

findings.title: Production narration remains in additional reader-text locations
findings.evidence: Clauses address later HTML/motion implementation, unrestricted multi-agent implementation, draft status or integration handoff after useful learner material. These are additional locations in the earlier IR-07 category, not reissued old locations.
findings.remedy: Move production-authority clauses to existing handoff. Keep learner experiments, evidence links, synthetic labels and actual-versus-planned limitations.
findings.acceptance: Reader text remains a connected explanation; surrounding changed-input exercises and qualifications are preserved.
findings.support: cases-people-data.md: PD-03; cases-health-industry.md: HI-04; cases-finance-commerce.md: additional IR-07 locations

findings.title: Enterprise sidecar conflates undelivered and pending-inspection quantity
findings.evidence: remaining_delivery_qty=3, but requested=12 and received=10 mean two undelivered; the third unit is already received and pending inspection. Prose correctly separates them.
findings.remedy: Use pending_inspection_qty=1 and not_received_qty=2 or a clearly named remaining-fulfillment quantity.
findings.acceptance: Text, machine fields and any visualization show 9 accepted +1 pending inspection +2 not received =12.

findings.title: Enterprise prose describes an unechoed prerequisite-version receipt field
findings.evidence: Chapter receipt claims used prerequisite version 8 and result version 9; fake/HTTP return result version only. Validation compares returned version with persisted expected_version+1; lab-guide narrower wire description agrees with code.
findings.remedy: Describe the implemented comparison accurately or add expected-version echo to both adapters and independent provider/checks.
findings.acceptance: A reader comparing chapter, wire fields and validator can locate every claimed observation, with no inferred value described as returned evidence.

findings.title: Changed enterprise revision keeps fixed r3 identities
findings.evidence: A reapproved revision 4 still uses APR-42-r3, CHG-42/r3/apply and OP-42 and conflicts with the original persisted intent. The lab explicitly covers one fixed example, so its original chain remains valid.
findings.remedy: Either enforce/document fixed r3 input or derive identities from change/revision and use a distinct operation for a genuinely new approved intent.
findings.acceptance: The stated domain is enforced; if r4 is supported it can proceed after reapproval while stale approval, same-key changed-content and duplicate-intent checks remain effective.

findings.title: X01 answer streaming and authorization boundary is ambiguous
findings.evidence: SSE/resumable tokens coexist with a generation-then-authorization-then-delivery sequence. Buffered progress-only or per-emission interpretations are possible. Boolean may_deliver checks do not model chunk or replay boundaries; the chapter honestly says SSE is untested.
findings.remedy: Choose buffered answer versus incremental content semantics, define current authorization for initial/subsequent/replayed content and keep consumed usage separate from delivery success.
findings.acceptance: Synthetic traces cover revocation before first byte, between chunks and before reconnect; prior authorized delivery remains recorded and subsequent delivery obeys the chosen policy.
findings.support: cases-people-data.md: PD-01; coordinator rating low (ambiguity, no demonstrated leak)
